title: International Roaming Services Regulations
text:
International Roaming Services Regulations
This regulation was issued by the Communications & Information
Technology Regulatory Authority (CITRA)
In the State of Kuwait
Version No.: 1.0
Regulation No. ____ of 2021

Article (1)
Definitions
In application of the provisions of this regulation, the words and phrases contained
therein shall have the same meanings as those set forth in Law No. 37 of 2014 and
its amendment (Law No. 98 of 2015) as well as its regulations. In addition, the
following words and phrases shall have the meanings set forth against each of
them, unless the context requires otherwise:
Law: Law No. 37 of 2014 and its amendment (Law No. 98 of 2015)
International Roaming Service: enabling the roaming subscriber, through his/her
mobile device, to send or receive an international roaming call or a roaming SMS,
or use the data roaming service while being outside Kuwait, in coordination
between the mobile telecommunication services provider and the network operator
in the host country.
Data Roaming Service: enabling the roaming subscriber to use exchange packets
of telecommunication data through the mobile device connected to the
telecommunications network in the host country, including sending and receipt of
multimedia messages, and does not include sending and receipt of calls or SMSs.
International roaming call: A mobile voice call made by the roaming subscriber
originating from the host country’s network and ending at a public
telecommunications network, whether inside or outside Kuwait, or a voice call,
received by the roaming subscriber, originating from a public telecommunications
network, whether inside or outside Kuwait, and ending at the host country’s
network.
Roaming SMS: A short text message sent by the roaming subscriber originating
from the host country’s network and ending at a public telecommunications
network, whether inside or outside Kuwait, or received by the roaming subscriber

and originating from a public telecommunications network, whether inside or
outside Kuwait, and ending at the host country’s network.
SMS Alert Messages: The short text message that mobile telecommunication
service providers are obligated to send to the roaming subscriber under these
regulations.
Host country’s network: A public terrestrial mobile telecommunications network
located outside Kuwait that allows the roaming subscriber to make and receive an
international roaming call, send and receive a roaming SMS or use data roaming
service in coordination with the mobile telecommunication service provider.
Subscriber: Any person who is a party of a contract with a public
telecommunications operator to provide telecommunications services.
Roaming subscriber: A subscriber that exists outside the State of Kuwait and for
whom the international roaming service has been activated.
Mobile Telecommunications Service Provider: The licensee who has obtained a
license to provide mobile telecommunications services by the Authority, and
provides the roaming subscriber with mobile telecommunications services upon the
activation of the service.

Article (2)
Scope of application of the Regulations’ provisions
The provisions of this regulation shall be applied to mobile telecommunication
service providers regarding the provision of international roaming services.
Article (3)
Controls for providing International Roaming Service
The mobile telecommunications service provider, when providing the international
roaming service, shall consider the following:
1. The mobile telecommunications service provider shall enable the subscriber
to use the international roaming service only after requesting such service by
the subscriber through the available communication channels (call center,
website, application, branches, etc.).
2. The mobile telecommunication service provider shall enable the subscriber
to use the data roaming service only after requesting such service separately
from the request of the international roaming calls service and other
telecommunication services.
3. The data roaming service shall be provided in the form of bundles to be clear
and limited in terms of value and quantity, and it shall not be provided by
paying for the service prices as per the consumption of capacities (outside
bundles).
4. Ensuring that the roaming subscriber is sufficiently informed, before and
after activating the service, about the tariff imposed on the international
roaming service.
5. The tariff of the international roaming service submitted to the subscriber
shall be in Kuwaiti dinars.
6. Enabling the roaming subscriber, through an appropriate means, to monitor
the use of the data roaming service and control the expenses resulting
therefrom, free of charge.
7. Providing all subscribers with data about suspending or activating the
international roaming service.

Article (4)
SMS Alert Message
The mobile telecommunications service provider shall provide the roaming
subscriber, if it enters any foreign country or upon its request, with an automatic
SMS alert message at the earliest and free of charge, provided that this message
shall include, via a free access online link or any other free means, the following
information in both Arabic and English languages:
1- The maximum tariff for making an international roaming call (in Kuwaiti
dinars).
2- The maximum tariff for receiving an international roaming call (in Kuwaiti
dinars).
3- The maximum tariff for sending a roaming SMS and the extent to which any
tariff is applied for receiving it (in Kuwaiti dinars).
4- Tariff and data of the activated data roaming service bundle (in Kuwaiti
dinars).
5- Details of the mobile telecommunications service provider’s website, how to
obtain all information related to the international roaming service tariff and
the list of countries and networks approved in each country by the means
provided by the service provider (the website, its specific application, live
chat and other means of communication).
6- How to access emergency services, with the ability to call the emergency
services numbers in the host country, free of charge.
7- Details and method of contacting the customer service center of the mobile
telecommunications service provider through the free communication
channels provided by the service provider (Livechat, WhatsApp and other
means of communication).
8- Choosing a specific service provider during the international roaming, and
reminding it to set up its device settings to choose the service provider.
9- Information about the available bundles that help to reduce the bill cost
during the international roaming, as well as how to subscribe thereon.

Article (5)
Tariff Updates
The mobile telecommunication service provider shall, as soon as possible, provide
the roaming subscriber, by an automatic SMS alert message containing free access
online link or any other free means, with any updates that may occur to the
applicable international roaming services’ tariff.
Article (6)
The financial credit limit for the international roaming services for the post-
payment category
A. The mobile communications service provider shall apply a monthly financial
limit of fifty dinars as a tariff due on the international roaming service for
the roaming subscriber contracting by the post-paid services system, unless
another financial limit is agreed upon.
B. The mobile communications service provider, if the roaming subscriber
exceeds the financial credit limit, shall notify it, via an automatic SMS alert
message sent to its transferred device, with the procedures to be followed to
continue benefiting from the international roaming service and the costs
resulted in each additional call unit. In the event that the roaming subscriber
does not respond to this notice, the mobile telecommunications service
provider shall immediately suspend providing the international roaming
service. However, in the event that the telecommunications service provider
does not commit to interrupting the service, the subscriber shall not be
charged with any additional amounts that exceed the monthly financial limit
specified in item (6/A).
C. The service provider shall notify the customer, through SMS that contains a
free access online link or any other free means, with the pricing and usage
details according to the service provider’s latest update.
D. The roaming subscriber may request the amendment or cancellation of the
financial credit limit through the means provided by the telecommunications

service provider, and the mobile telecommunications service provider’s
approval of the subscriber’s request is required (and the mobile
telecommunications service provider shall decide on the request within one
working day from receiving it free of charge, and the approval shall be
communicated to the subscriber by SMS). While amending or canceling the
financial credit limit shall not entail amending any of the other terms of
service.
E. Such agreement shall be substantiated by any means of proof, along with
showing the new credit limits for the subscriber to be referred to in the event
of any dispute between the subscriber and the mobile telecommunication
service provider.
Article (7)
Notices of the percentage of the financial credit limit usage and the remaining
balance
A. The mobile telecommunication service provider shall send a notification, by
an automatic SMS alert message, to the roaming subscriber who contracted
under the post-payment services system through its mobile device when the
use of the international roaming service reaches the following percentages,
calculated from the monthly financial credit limit (in Kuwaiti dinars), along
with showing the percentage of units used:
1. Fifty percent (50%).
2. Seventy-five percent (75%).
3. One hundred percent (100%).
B. The mobile telecommunication service provider shall notify the roaming
subscribers, who contracted under the pre-paid services system, of the
balance remaining in their accounts as a result of using the international
roaming service via an automatic SMS alert message after each use of the
international roaming service. While the subscriber shall not be charged any
additional amounts when the pre-paid balance runs out.

Article (8)
Compliance
Without prejudice to the provisions of any other law, In the event that the service
provider violates the provisions of this regulations or one of the licensing terms,
the Authority shall have the right to take the measures and penalties stipulated in
the Authority’s law.
